file(GLOB logon_rc_deps res/*.*)
add_rc_deps(logon.rc ${logon_rc_deps})

# logon.scr is all Rust (logon-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/logon-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# logon.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/logon-rust/src/logon/logon.rs)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(logon_res OBJECT logon.rc)
target_compile_definitions(logon_res PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_include_directories(logon_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
add_cargo_module(logon logon-cargo logon.scr
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE logon-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS logon_res psdk)
